questions.question: What happens in a chemical reaction?

answers.a: The atoms disappear and new atoms are formed
answers.b: A mixture of the same substances is formed
answers.c: The reactants disappear and new substances with different properties are formed

questions.question: Is the melting of ice a chemical reaction?

answers.a: No, because ice is a mixture
answers.b: No, it is a change of state. They remain water molecules
answers.d: Yes, because a new substance is formed

questions.question: What happens to the atoms during a chemical reaction?

answers.a: The atoms change into another kind of atom
answers.d: They are arranged differently. No atoms are added and no atoms are lost

answers.b: sodium (s) + water (l) → sodium hydroxide solution (aq) + hydrogen (g)
answers.c: sodium hydroxide solution (aq) + hydrogen (g) → sodium (s) + water (l)

questions.question: What is a decomposition reaction?

answers.a: A reaction in which a mixture is separated
answers.b: A reaction in which a substance only changes state
answers.c: A reaction in which one reactant is split into several products
answers.d: A reaction in which two substances combine to form one new substance

questions.question: What is a synthesis reaction?

answers.a: A reaction in which one new substance is made from two or more substances
answers.b: A reaction in which one substance is split up
answers.c: A reaction in which nothing changes
answers.d: A reaction in which only heat is released

questions.question: How do you test for hydrogen gas?

answers.b: With a burning splint: the flame goes out
answers.c: With a burning splint: you hear a pop (a popping sound)
answers.d: With a glowing splint: it bursts into flame

questions.question: How do you test for oxygen gas?

answers.a: With a burning splint: the flame goes out
answers.b: With a glowing splint: it bursts into flame
answers.c: With a burning splint: you hear a pop

questions.question: How do you test for carbon dioxide?

answers.a: With a burning splint: you hear a pop
answers.b: With a burning splint: the flame goes out, or with limewater: it turns cloudy (white)
answers.c: With white copper(II) sulfate: it turns blue
answers.d: With a glowing splint: it bursts into flame

questions.question: What do you put in front of a molecular formula to balance the atoms: a subscript or a coefficient?

answers.b: A coefficient. You must never change the subscript (the small number)
answers.c: A subscript, because it is written at the bottom

Is this equation balanced? 4 NH<sub>3</sub> + 5 O<sub>2</sub> → 4 NO + 6 H<sub>2</sub>O

answers.a: No: there are more N atoms on the left than on the right
answers.b: No: there are more H atoms on the left than on the right
answers.c: No: there are more O atoms on the right than on the left
answers.d: Yes: on the left and the right there are 4 N, 12 H and 10 O

questions.question: Is this equation balanced? H<sub>2</sub> + O<sub>2</sub> → H<sub>2</sub>O

answers.a: No: on the left there are 2 O atoms and on the right 1 O atom
answers.b: No: there are 2 H atoms on the left and 1 H atom on the right
answers.c: No: there are more H atoms on the right than on the left
answers.d: Yes: there are equal numbers of H atoms and O atoms on the left and right

questions.question: Simplify: 4 H<sub>2</sub> + 2 O<sub>2</sub> → 4 H<sub>2</sub>O

answers.c: 4 H<sub>2</sub> + 2 O<sub>2</sub> → 4 H<sub>2</sub>O (this one is already as simple as possible)

questions.question: In a closed container, 50 g of reactants react completely to form products. How many g of products are formed?

answers.a: 50 g, because the mass stays the same (law of conservation of mass)
